architecture_reasoning: The binding constraint has moved off the generator. Every remaining defect class is either an inventory limit, a grounding gap inside one existing gate, or an exception path used too readily; none is a common architectural layer shared across disciplines in the way the first two root causes were. The stop rule therefore applies and no third universal patch was written. The next investment is contrast-seed and evidence acquisition strong enough to supply genuinely competitive same-category alternatives, not further generator gates.

defect_comparison_with_r2.note: Both runs were reviewed against the strict bar, so defect counts are comparable even though pass rates are not.

fail_closed_no_valid_contrast_set.reason: Carried forward unchanged from the r2 retest. No source supplies a clinical discriminator separating appendicitis from the right-lower-quadrant causes that imaging exists to rule out, and manufacturing one was refused.

Two candidate contrast sets were attempted. The anchored decision keys supplemental oxygen, and every same-dimension contrast edge available for this study unit is a medication, so any option set is three medications against a lone supportive-care key. OPTION_SEMANTIC_CATEGORY_PARITY rejects that set and no honest exception exists, because the three-drugs-plus-oxygen pattern is a structural cue rather than a comparable set. Inventing a fourth non-medication competitor was refused.

fix_effect_on_prior_failure_modes: EXCLUSION_BY_EXPLICIT_STEM_NEGATION appeared in all five disciplines in r2 and survives in one item in one discipline. KEY_AS_CATEGORY_ODD_ONE_OUT appeared in four disciplines and survives in two items. The unsupported competitor-evidence mode closed in r2 and did not return. Evidence entailment and independent context both pass.
production_change_summary: Staged schema 1.4 (STAGE_SEQUENCE_V5) adds the SEMANTIC_ITEM_ACCEPTANCE_V2 layer to scripts/qbank/chapter_staged_generation.py as five fail-closed gates and one calibrated acceptance contract. CANDIDATE_VISIBLE_STEM_FEATURE_MAP replaces verbatim stem quotation with normalized semantic features that may be integrated from several grounded features. NUMERIC_DERIVATION_VALIDATION recomputes every declared derived value with Decimal over a sixteen-formula registry and escalates anything unregistered to an independent verifier. EVIDENCE_ENTAILMENT_ADJUDICATION replaces reference existence with an adjudicated entailment status and support scope, and refuses a general concept source behind a scenario-deciding claim. TERMINAL_EXCLUSION_REVIEW rejects a negative checklist sentence or a closing negation whose apparent purpose is to falsify distractors. OPTION_SEMANTIC_CATEGORY_PARITY rejects a lone-category key or distractor unless an independent reviewer records a justified exception, and PRE_ASSEMBLY_SEMANTIC_SET_REVIEW gates the whole semantic set before any wording exists. Schema 1.0 through 1.3 behaviour is unchanged. 48 new regression tests.

root_cause_matrix.method: Each r2 defect was attributed to its earliest causal layer, with the Cardiology pilot and the accepted baseline items as controls. Downstream symptoms of one cause are not counted twice.
root_cause_matrix.primary_root_cause: The architecture never modelled the information relationship between the stem and the option set. It validated evidence lineage, surface wording and structural parity after the fact, but nothing ever asked whether a stem clause exists for the patient or for the item, whether cited evidence entails the claim it is attached to at the required granularity, or whether the option set is one category of answer to one question. Given a requirement that each competitor be defeated by a stem feature, the cheapest way to satisfy it is a terminal negative checklist; given a requirement that the key be uniquely correct, the cheapest way is to make the key the only member of its action category.
root_cause_matrix.reviewer_calibration_only: The 14 r2 RATIONALE_DEFICIENCY findings are reclassified under the calibrated standard: the imperative register is an enhancement opportunity, not a fatal defect.
secondary_root_causes: Evidence acceptance tested reference existence, so a general concept page could stand behind a scenario-specific discriminator and a claim could carry a citation while misstating the source.
No layer recomputed a derived quantity a stem asserted about itself, which is how an Alvarado score of 5 survived beside findings summing to 8.
The reasoning-chain lineage rule bound the key rationale to the final chain step, so an imperatively written chain produced a rationale addressed to the item writer rather than the candidate.

surviving_failure_modes.note: The deterministic detector fires only when the distractors share a single category. In PHELO-I02 the distractors span two categories, so no odd-one-out is detected even though the key remains the only option answering the lead-in. In PED-I02 the finding fired and was waived by the exception path, which the reviewer did not accept.

Where the fixed contrast inventory holds no genuinely competitive same-category alternative, the competitor proof can still be written honestly and still yield a distractor a real candidate would not choose. This is an inventory limit rather than a gate failure.

NUMERIC_DERIVATION_VALIDATION recomputes the total from the declared components and caught nothing here because the arithmetic over those components was correct. One declared component contradicted the stem: the stem records mild nausea while the Alvarado nausea component was declared as zero, so the true score is 6 rather than the stated 5. The gate validates arithmetic but not component extraction.

SURG-I03 closes with a positively worded fitness sentence that carries no negation marker and therefore passes the deterministic detector, but it enumerates the laparoscopy contraindication list and exists to defeat one option.
